Name: Spa Shortcut
Author: mkzanchi
Description:
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

This mod changes the way your character enters and exits the spa. Going through the front door will take you directly to the pool room. Leaving the pool room will take you straight back outside.

Your character will also be able to run in the pool room and will wear their usual outfit instead of a swimsuit.

Manifest.Name: Spa Shortcut
Manifest.Description: Go directly to the pool room from the front door of the spa, and vice versa.
Manifest.Author: mkzanchi
